inspection.method: Each complete original 5100x3300 PNG viewed individually. Every one-page PDF independently rendered with PDFium at 300 dpi and compared to its PNG.
inspection.render_rounding: Existing production one-row crop 5100x3301 to 5100x3300 reproduced; no production images changed.
inspection.scope: Static print audit only; not native/cold identity, complete dimension/manufacturing validation or a successful full build. Full run stopped on arbor_pedestal after these 51 successful drawings.

baseline_attribution.head: 3c0c4a97e69ead5f04fa760b8aa507c16143172d
baseline_attribution.facts: Measuring-stick and harmonic-base builder/spec and recipe placement calls unchanged; drawing entry/factory and shared finalizer/template changed. add_property_linked_note and insert_hole_table AST unchanged. Cone-tip datum/layout coordinates unchanged; callouts moved to source author/read-only verification. No same-source native print baseline at 55056 was compared.

items.name: fulcrum-shaft
items.observation: Main 182.00 length, end diameter/tolerance, FCFs, datum, notes and title are legible; no full-sheet clipping observed. End-view leaders converge but remain traceable at this resolution.

items.name: slotted-screw
items.observation: Three views, 8.00/2.50/22.00 dimensions and all 17 note lines are readable. Upper head-height tail remains inside the border. Exact source identities and cold acceptance are outside this eye pass.

items.name: cone-tip-adjuster
items.observation: Parenthesized reference diameter, thread designation, cup/slot dimensions, FCFs and complete lower note block are legible. Several leaders converge at small end-view centers; no clipped value observed.

items.name: pinion-spring
items.observation: Formed profile, top view, dimensions and full notes are legible. Gray hole callout has lower contrast but remains readable; tiny tip geometry/attachment cannot be certified visually.

items.name: foot-screw
items.observation: Three views, principal dimensions, complete thread/slot notes and title fields are legible without obvious clipping.

items.name: gooseneck-set-screw
items.observation: PART wraps onto a second line across its lower cell border and overlaps DWG. NO. label. Main dimensions and complete notes remain legible. Confirmed print presentation defect; no source correctness inference.

items.name: rocker-arm
items.observation: Basic dimensions and full seven-item note block are visible; last line fits just above lower border. Gray reference/hole dimensions have reduced contrast. End-hole leader convergence is dense; attachment correctness is not an image claim.

items.name: transgear-pinion
items.observation: Gear data, bore tolerance/THRU-REAM, end-face FCF and full notes are readable. Tooth profile/count correctness requires source checks.

items.name: transgear-stub
items.observation: Stepped diameters/lengths, FCFs, datum, slot isometric and full two-line note block are readable; no clear clipped text.

items.name: tube-frame
items.observation: Complete length/end views, FCFs and five notes are readable. MATERIAL wraps below its cell into the geometric-tolerancing footer area; FINISH is densely packed. This is a visible title-field fit defect, consistent with the deferred template work.

items.name: clamp-screw
items.observation: Dimensions and complete thread/slot note block are legible; no obvious border or title collision.

items.name: bracket-screw
items.observation: Three views, dimensions, thread/slot notes and title are legible without obvious clipping.

items.name: transgear-feed-pinion
items.observation: Gear data, bore/FCF and complete notes are readable; wrapped PART second line overlaps DWG. NO. label.

items.name: spring-hook
items.observation: Three views, 7.60/2.50/1.40 dimensions, finish and four notes are legible; no clipped value observed.

items.name: cone-tip-block
items.observation: Datum B triangle/stem overlaps 14.00 width text and datum D overlaps 12.00 depth text. Diagonal leader crosses 5/16-18 Tapped Hole text; FCF caption reaches isometric outline. Dense bottom notes remain visible but small. Not a clean print.

items.name: connecting-rod
items.observation: Ring diameter/tolerance/BORE labels crowd and touch the ring outline and leaders; 8.00 lies tightly between shank outlines. Values remain readable at this scale, but clean stroke separation is not established. Notes and title fit.

items.name: channel-spring-installed
items.observation: Complete spring data and both views are visible. Wrapped PART second line overlaps DWG. NO. label. Fine coil/end connections are too small for geometry/continuity proof.

items.name: magnifying-clamp
items.observation: The front-view upper horizontal edge/extension line runs through the THRU - SLIP FIT diameter-6-rod callout; nearby finish text is tight to the right outline. Main values and full notes are readable, but the sheet is not cleanly separated.

items.name: cone-gear-shaft
items.observation: Five end diameters/tolerances, axial stations, FCFs and full note block are readable. Large-end Ra 1.6 lies over shaft/centerline ink; fine separation of those strokes is not clean. No cut-off text observed.

items.name: cone-gear
items.observation: Complete gear-family table and notes, bore dimension, datum and FCF are visible. Fine 120-tooth edges alias in side view; tooth-form accuracy is not established by the preview.

items.name: pinion-pivot-shaft
items.observation: End-diameter diagonal leader runs through the 0.00/-0.02 tolerance stack. Main length, profile FCF, notes and title remain legible; this end callout is not cleanly separated.

items.name: measuring-stick
items.observation: Manufacturing-note block runs below sheet border, overlaps SOLIDWORKS footer and is cut by page bottom. Later note text is not fully printable. Main scale/200.00/8.00 views are visible, but complete-print acceptance fails.

items.name: boss-hook
items.observation: Three principal dimensions, full five-note block and title are readable. No clear clipping/collision.

items.name: alignment-pinion
items.observation: THRU - REAM / PRESS FIT prints with both tolerance values; complete gear/fit notes and title are legible. Dense long-pinion tooth lines merge at overview scale; exact form is not visually established.

items.name: cylinder-gear-shaft
items.observation: Length, full notes and FCFs are legible. End-diameter tolerance stack is tightly packed against the circle/leader; clean clearance is uncertain at the overview.

items.name: fillister-screw
items.observation: Thread-only #4-40 UNC-2A prints without residual numeric diameter and all notes are visible. Vertical dimension/centerline strokes pass through the 4.00/UNDERHEAD LENGTH text region; this is not a pristine layout.

items.name: knife-mount
items.observation: 29.37 vertical dimension line passes through the diameter-12.00 THRU callout text. Other values, FCF, tapped-hole label and complete notes are legible.

items.name: crank-arm
items.observation: All views, notes and labeled dimensions are visible. Left bore/radius leaders converge tightly; gray 8.00/BASIC and hole labels overlap projected/internal lines. Their values can be read but clean separation and native attachment are not certified.

items.name: hanger-screw
items.observation: Three views and complete dimension-by-note/thread block are readable; no graphical dimensions are invented by this audit.

items.name: swing-stop-screw
items.observation: Three views, diameter and full underhead/thread/slot note block are readable without obvious clipping.

items.name: crank-handle
items.observation: Grip dimensions/FCFs and full profile notes are legible. Three-line FINISH spills into MATERIAL label/value region; template presentation defect.

items.name: crankshaft
items.observation: BEARING JOURNAL/Ra 1.6 text crosses the shaft outline/centerline; bottom BASIC 4.00 is crossed by extension ink. Dimensions/notes remain reconstructable, but stroke separation is not clean.

items.name: lever-wire
items.observation: All notes are readable and expressly say formed hook, hub wrap and developed cut length are undefined; DO NOT RELEASE is printed. This is a declared manufacturing-definition limit, not a newly inferred missing geometry defect. Slender views do not resolve endpoints.

items.name: lag-screw
items.observation: Driver-face slot, 22/63/6 dimensions and all thread/slot notes are legible within the sheet. Thread shape is explicitly omitted in views; no native thread validation inferred.

items.name: platen-guide
items.observation: Nine-row hole table, location tags, datums and FCFs are legible. End-view 10.00 extension/arrow region is dense; exact attachment and small clearances are not certified by this eye pass.

items.name: channel-lever
items.observation: Five-view layout shows separated BASIC length pairs and legible FCFs; all eight manufacturing notes fit, with the last line close to the lower border. Gray reference annotations are lower contrast; no new cold/identity acceptance inferred.

items.name: pinion-handle
items.observation: Vertical extension/model strokes run through 10.00/BORE DEPTH and BODY HOLE; REAM THRU text; the OAL extension also traverses two FCF bodies. Notes and numeric values remain visible, but the annotation layout is not clean.

items.name: rocker-arm-support
items.observation: Four-row hole table, three orthographic views, isometric, datums, FCFs and complete notes/title are legible. No full manufacturing/identity certification inferred from the print.

items.name: pinion-cam
items.observation: The Ø10.32 callout begins outside the left drawing border (still inside the PDF page). A vertical extension stroke crosses the 1.40 ±0.05/BOTH END FACES region. All notes are visible; the annotation layout is not clean.

items.name: frame-side-screw
items.observation: Three views, 7/3/12.70 dimensions and all thread/slot manufacturing notes fit and are legible.

items.name: harmonic-base
items.observation: Manufacturing note block extends below the lower border and is clipped at the actual page edge. Hole-table rows F1–F4 overlap the lower-right side view, dimension/FCF text and title/footer. DATUM B LONG SIDE caption is crossed by the base outline. Complete print is not readable.

items.name: gooseneck
items.observation: Elevation, bend radius, arm length and all seven notes are legible and fit. Isometric scale caption touches the lower tube endpoint; small screw/plug details are not resolved by this sheet.

items.name: pinion-lever
items.observation: Ra1.6 finish symbol overlaps the lower runout FCF body, and a diagonal crown leader crosses the 2.00/end-wall callout. Full notes and values are visible; the isometric scale caption touches the title-block upper rule.

items.name: cone-lock-knob
items.observation: Diameters, thread designation, axial dimensions, dome radius, FCFs and notes are legible. Top centerline extends past the inner border but not beyond the page.

items.name: output-fixture
items.observation: All four manufacturing notes and three view dimensions are legible, but wrapped note line starts (including note 2/3) extend outside the left inner drawing border. They are still within the PDF page.

items.name: pen-wire
items.observation: Straight blank, 62.70 length and all three manufacturing notes are legible within the border. The notes explicitly defer forming/termination to assembly; thin endpoints are not a connection proof.

items.name: cone-pivot-screw
items.observation: Thread-end, side, slot and isometric views, thread designation, FCFs and all notes are legible. Head/shoulder frames are separated and center references retained; this is a current output eye pass, not a new cold proof.

items.name: pinion-cam-pin
items.observation: Final-size tolerance, crown radius/profile, seated-end flatness and all notes are legible. Several leaders cross one another away from text; exact endpoint identities and tiny crown shape are not certified.

items.name: magnifying-lever
items.observation: Three views, R3 both-ends callout, 162 to far dome centre and full notes are legible with space around them.

items.name: guide-lock
items.observation: Main dimensions, BASIC locations, datums, hole-position FCF and full notes are legible within the sheet. Gray BASIC/hole callouts are lower contrast; no native attachment acceptance inferred.

items.name: pen-frame
items.observation: Three views, 25.25/40 dimensions and complete asymmetry/depth/thread notes are legible and within the border. Fine thread geometry is not established by this print.
